selection_score: mean 5-fold CV ROC AUC of LR and HGBT inside SPA
tabpfn_role: evaluated at each selected panel; not used for candidate scoring
validation_role: recorded for comparison only; not used for selection
one_se_method: per-fold mean(LR,HGBT) AUC; SE across 5 folds
note: Corrected from 21 to 22 using the SE of the per-fold selection score; the earlier 21 used a mean-of-per-model-SE approximation.
final_panel_rationale: Clinical parsimony choice, not a statistical optimum; 1-SE selects 22; 10 features has EPV 25.0 and 8/10 overlap with the original 14; validation was not used for selection.
figure_note: Figure 3 marks only the 10-feature panel with a dashed vertical line; the 14- and 22-feature panels are discussed in the response letter but are not marked in the figure.
